project.detect.title: Detect the project
project.detect.summary: Report what the project already has: package manager and scripts, languages, hook setup, CI, issue tracker and decision records.
project.detect.description: Read-only. Every observation names the file it came from. Detection describes and never decides: it enables nothing, installs nothing and assumes no tool. Commands offered for the check block come from scripts and targets the project itself declares. Facts land under /blocks/project/detected; commands land under /blocks/check/config/commands. When two files offer a value for one key, both are reported and the project's explicit config wins.
